en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5349 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, who narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) regarding

a man who placed his servant on an animal, and the animal trampled a man.
Imam (as) said: "The compensation is upon the master."
